qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

capability.highByteCopy: Tier one copies low bytes, legacy high bytes, and immediates into AH/CH/DH/BH with the source staged before destination mutation. Surrounding bits, NZCV, and the pending lazy-flags record remain unchanged.
capability.memoryExtendMove: Memory-source MOVSX/MOVZX uses one restartable scalar read followed by the existing register extension lowering. A read fault returns to the block checkpoint before any preceding high-byte copy is published.

verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,455 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Low-byte, high-byte-alias, and immediate sources preserve surrounding destination bits and match the interpreter; the measured two-instruction block matches exact state and rolls the earlier BH write back on a failing memory read.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: Attempt totals are close, but the executions still have different interrupt, cache, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Counter movements demonstrate wider native coverage; the elapsed increase is run noise and not a performance claim.

interpretation: The measured high-byte-copy plus memory-MOVZX block is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 121,786 of 223,679 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
